source_clause: LS1.) When the (-, +) seat control buttons are pressed from the door control for lumbar & bolster, if the lower screen is not in the stowed position, switch the tab on the lower screen to the Seats tab. If the lower screen is in the stowed position, display the Seat Control Popup on the head unit (popup times out after 5 seconds of not interaction). If the lower screen is in the stowed position, and the user is already in the climate section on the main head unit, switch the user to the Seats tab.
reasoning: 驗證目標：13.2（LS1.）以 lower screen 是否 stowed、使用者是否已在 climate section 兩條件分出三個分支，三個 037 leaf 恰對應之，故一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：第九軸之措辭取自本節自身「the lower screen」而非 6.3 之「non-foldable secondary lower screen」，故標 spec-derived；stowed／retracted 依 19 §2.2 判定測試入 pre_conditions，因三條之驗證目標即該狀態下之行為。為什麼這樣切：條文之三分支互斥且各有獨立結果，合併會使任一分支失敗都無法定位。刻意略過：popup 樣式與 Seats tab 內容本節未定義，寫入即造值（§8.4.1）；5 秒 timeout 為條文明載，照用。

tcs.tc_title: Seats tab opens on the lower screen when it is not stowed
tcs.test_item: When the (-, +) seat control buttons are pressed from the door control for lumbar & bolster, if the lower screen is not in the stowed position, the system shall switch the tab on the lower screen to the Seats tab
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with a lower screen that provides seat controls (13.2)
2. [spec-derived] The door control carries the seat control (-, +) buttons for lumbar and bolster (13.2)
3. [spec-verbatim] The lower screen is not in the stowed position (13.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Note which tab is currently shown on the lower screen
2. Press "-" on the door seat control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The tab shown on the lower screen is not the Seats tab
2. The lower screen switches to the Seats tab

tcs.tc_title: Seat Control Popup appears on the head unit when the lower screen is stowed
tcs.test_item: When the (-, +) seat control buttons are pressed from the door control for lumbar & bolster, if the lower screen is in the stowed position, the system shall display the Seat Control Popup on the head unit, and the popup shall time out after 5 seconds of not interaction
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with a lower screen that provides seat controls (13.2)
2. [spec-derived] The door control carries the seat control (-, +) buttons for lumbar and bolster (13.2)
3. [spec-verbatim] The lower screen is in the stowed position (13.2)
4. [spec-derived] The user is not in the climate section on the main head unit (13.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "-" on the door seat control
2. Do not interact with the head unit for 5 seconds
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Seat Control Popup is displayed on the head unit
2. The Seat Control Popup is no longer displayed

tcs.tc_title: Seats tab is opened when the user is already in the climate section
tcs.test_item: When the (-, +) seat control buttons are pressed from the door control for lumbar & bolster, if the lower screen is in the stowed position and the user is already in the climate section on the main head unit, the system shall switch the user to the Seats tab
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with a lower screen that provides seat controls (13.2)
2. [spec-derived] The door control carries the seat control (-, +) buttons for lumbar and bolster (13.2)
3. [spec-verbatim] The lower screen is in the stowed position (13.2)
4. [spec-verbatim] The user is already in the climate section on the main head unit (13.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Note which tab is currently shown in the climate section on the head unit
2. Press "-" on the door seat control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The tab shown in the climate section is not the Seats tab
2. The head unit switches to the Seats tab
